note: Re-judged 2026-10-16: same unit as RFC8956-3.1-1, moved verbatim to core. The quote carries both clauses. Encoding is proven by the canonical-bytes assertions. Decoding: inputs with 0xff padding must parse without error, and comp.Prefix() must equal the pattern-only prefix (::7f00:0:0:0/72, 103:8000::/17) with the exact offset. A decoder that read padding into the match, or rejected nonzero padding, fails require.NoError or the Prefix assertion.
